title: fanoutqa: Identify the host cities of the Summer Olympic Games from 2000 to 2020 and name the main stadiums used in each of these Olympics. (c64872786e1a2ab6)

chat_history.content: Identify the host cities of the Summer Olympic Games from 2000 to 2020 and name the main stadiums used in each of these Olympics.

content.content:
We need to list host cities for Summer Olympics from 2000 to 2020 (i.e., 2000 Sydney, 2004 Athens, 2008 Beijing, 2012 London, 2016 Rio de Janeiro, 2020 Tokyo). Need main stadiums used (the main Olympic stadium/primary venue for opening/closing ceremonies). Provide list.

We might need verification but we likely know. However might need to verify main stadium names: 2000 - Stadium Australia (also known as Sydney Olympic Stadium). 2004 - Athens Olympic Stadium (also called Olympic Stadium, Athens). 2008 - Beijing National Stadium (Bird's Nest). 2012 - London Olympic Stadium (now called London Stadium). 2016 - Estádio Olímpico João Havelange (also known as Engenhão). 2020 - Japan National Stadium (also known as New National Stadium). Provide.

We could also include other info like location, capacity. But question just asks identify host cities and name main stadiums. Provide a table.

We can answer directly without external tool. No need to call search.

content:
**Summer Olympic Games 2000 – 2020**

| Year | Host City (Country) | Main Olympic Stadium (used for the Opening & Closing Ceremonies) |
|------|---------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 2000 | Sydney, **Australia** | **Stadium Australia** (also known as Sydney Olympic Stadium; later renamed ANZ Stadium) |
| 2004 | Athens, **Greece** | **Athens Olympic Stadium** (officially “Olympic Stadium, Athens” – the central venue of the Athens Olympic Sports Complex) |
| 2008 | Beijing, **China** | **Beijing National Stadium** (commonly called the “Bird’s Nest”) |
| 2012 | London, **United Kingdom** | **London Olympic Stadium** (now the “London Stadium”, home of West Ham United FC) |
| 2016 | Rio de Janeiro, **Brazil** | **Estádio Olímpico João Havelange** (also known as “Engenhão”) |
| 2020* | Tokyo, **Japan** | **Japan National Stadium** (the newly built “New National Stadium”) |

\*The 2020 Summer Games were postponed to 2021 because of the COVID‑19 pandemic, but they retained the “Tokyo 2020” branding.

These stadiums served as the focal points of each edition’s opening and closing ceremonies and were the primary athletics (track‑and‑field) venues for the Games.
